definitions.explanation: An unexpected event, gift, or action planned to delight or astonish someone. Used almost exclusively in positive contexts in Japanese.

examples.japanese: サプライズ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave flowers as a surprise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧サプライズ⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: We threw a surprise party for the birthday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧サプライズ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演出|えんしゅつ}→演出：04460_enshutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}して→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: She was so moved by the surprise that she shed tears.

notes:
Unlike English "surprise," サプライズ in Japanese is used almost exclusively for pleasant, planned surprises — gifts, parties, proposals, etc. It does not carry the neutral or negative sense of being startled.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- サプライズ⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧: surprise party
- サプライズ⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧: surprise gift
- サプライズ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演出|えんしゅつ}→演出：04460_enshutsu⟧: surprise production/arrangement
- サプライズで〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do something as a surprise
- サプライズ⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧: surprise plan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}き→驚き：02562_odoroki⟧: surprise, astonishment (broader, includes negative surprise)
- ⟦びっくり→びっくり：03003_bikkuri⟧: startle, shock (more spontaneous reaction)
